title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + fix regional failover race condition
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Context: We observed a production incident where SLO-enforcer backoff + regional failover interacted and caused aggressive load-shedding in downstream regions. Root cause: a race between the SLO enforcer's backoff state machine and the regional failover handler that led to duplicate decrementing of active capacity counters and premature tripping of circuit breakers. This manifested as a 4-6 minute period of over-shedding during the incident window, impacting a subset of Dedicated tenants.

This PR is a targeted hotfix to stabilize the SLO enforcer under concurrent backoff and regional failover transitions. Changes include: 1) make state transitions for backoff/quarantine atomic via a new short-lived lock to prevent concurrent decrements; 2) reorder failover path so that regional handoff completes before applying local decrements; 3) add hysteresis smoothing to backoff threshold updates to avoid oscillation during bursty traffic; 4) instrument additional metric tags and logs to trace state transitions (slo_enforcer.state_change, slo_enforcer.backoff_origin); 5) add unit and integration tests that reproduce the race and validate stability; 6) add a canary job to the perf-canary suite that simulates failover under high concurrency.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests and integration tests added in this PR reproduce the race reliably in CI; initial CI run failed (race reproduced), code was adjusted, and subsequent CI runs pass. We ran a controlled canary in us-west-2 for 2 hours under synthetic burst traffic and observed no over-shedding; metrics attached in the incident ticket. Rollout plan: squash-merge to main, deploy to staging, run perf-canary, progressive rollout to Dedicated regions with feature flag off-by-default, enable for tenants impacted by the incident, monitor for 24h before global enable.

Notes: This change is intentionally minimal and avoids touching the routing/fallback code path beyond ordering changes. It does not change any API or config surface for customers. Related: ENG-2145 (SLO enforcer stability), SUP-7342 (support ticket with affected tenants).
commits: fix(slo-enforcer): add guarded state transition for backoff and quarantine
fix(regional-failover): reorder failover handoff to apply before local decrements
test(slo-enforcer): add unit test reproducing race between backoff and failover
perf(canary): add failover under load scenario to perf-canary suite
docs: add release note and rollout instructions
reviews: Jamie Morgan (reviewer): Found the root cause analysis clear. Asked to ensure the lock is short-lived to avoid throughput regressions. Requested a microbenchmark for the guarded path.
Aisha Patel (author): Added a microbenchmark in enforcer/state_machine_bench.rs and documented the lock cost; measured <0.5% p50 token latency impact under 95th percentile load.
Ravi Singh (reviewer): Verified ordering change in regional_failover handler; requested integration test that runs both handlers concurrently, added in tests/race_conditions.rs.
Elena Torres (approver): Approved after CI green and canary pass. Left a note to monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_hysteresis events for 48h post-rollout.
release_notes: Hotfix: Prevents over-shedding caused by a race between SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover (impact: Dedicated tenants during incidents).
Adds guarded state transitions and hysteresis smoothing to backoff logic.
No customer-facing API changes. Deploy as hotfix to main, stage, then progressive rollout.
